title: Tryptic (Trypticase) Soy Broth

references.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

purpose: The liquid form of TSA; used for broth culture, enrichment prior to plating, and inoculum preparation for downstream tests.
targetOrganisms: Broad range of bacteria, including many fastidious organisms

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

preparationSummary: Dissolve the dehydrated powder per the manufacturer's stated concentration, dispense, and sterilize.

sterilization.value: commonly autoclaved at 121°C for 15 minutes for typical volumes

storage: Store tightly capped, protected from contamination, per manufacturer guidance.
expectedAppearance: Clear, pale amber liquid; turbidity after inoculation indicates growth.
manufacturerNotes: Exact formulation (e.g. added dextrose/phosphate) varies by manufacturer — confirm against the product insert.
